message.content:
I don’t have access to live market feeds, so I can’t tell you the exact spot‑price right now.  
The most accurate way to get the current BTC/USD rate (or any other pair) is to look at one of the major crypto exchanges or aggregators:

| Source | Typical URL |
|--------|-------------|
| **CoinGecko** | https://www.coingecko.com/en/coins/bitcoin |
| **CoinMarketCap** | https://coinmarketcap.com/currencies/bitcoin/ |
| **Binance / Coinbase / Kraken** | Their public APIs or trading pages |

If you’re building an application, many services offer free REST endpoints – e.g., `https://api.coinbase.com/v2/prices/BTC-USD/buy` returns JSON with the latest buy price.  

For quick reference, as of my last update (mid‑May 2026), Bitcoin was hovering around $30–$35k USD per coin, but prices fluctuate wildly on a minute‑by‑minute basis. Check one of the sites above for the precise figure today.
